---
title: "Paper on frog escape decisions accepted in Behavioral Ecology"
description: "Microhabitat complexity and predator stimulus shape how frogs decide to flee."
date: "2026-10-07"
categories: [papers]
---

Our paper **"Microhabitat structural complexity and predator stimulus drive
predator escape decision by frogs"** (Provete, Citadini & Gomes) has been
accepted in *Behavioral Ecology*.

The preprint is available on
[bioRxiv](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.05.26.728007v1).
